description: fixes #59967 below is the output of example mentioned in the issue, not sure if its the right way to do it, but all the markdown tests passed, please suggest if any changes

comments.body:
Please put a space after `#` to follow the style of the surrounding code. Also: typo :-)
```suggestion
                    # Skip any additional blank lines and check indentation
```

```suggestion
                        # Multiple blank lines within indented content - allow it
```

But this test also passes with the *current* version of the code. You are not actually testing that your change does something!

I would recommend to just test the full HTML output as is done e.g. in line 1122 and in other places. That then also will catch other (intended or unintended) changes affecting this output.

Also, in your example, I don't think the code is indented far enough to be considered code: you need 4 spaces *plus* the current indent of the list, so here 6 spaces.

Indeed, your Markdown snippet, rendered by GitHub:

- item

    domaths(x::Number) = x + 5


    domath(x::Int) = x + 10


And here with the 6 space indentation

- item

      domaths(x::Number) = x + 5


      domath(x::Int) = x + 10

sorry for the wrong test, it does not check for code element in html, and also the issue was not indentation in markdown but indented code snippets in list render was inconsistent.
I have changed it to include the example mentioned in the issue itself

While it doesn't matter for the effectiveness of the test, let's still avoid a potentially confusing message: multiple blank lines now *do* work. Also, it is "indentation" not "indention".
```suggestion
- code block inside a list with more than one blank line with indentation works
```

```suggestion

  • code block inside a list with more than one blank line with indentation works

    ```

Your test currently only tests the "positive" case: that the list is not ended prematurely. But I think we should also verify that it still ends when it should end. How about adding something like this:
```suggestion
- another entry, now testing code blocks without fences

      # this is a code block
      x = 1 + 1
      
      
      # Two empty lines don't interrupt the code
      y = x * 3

- a final list entry

And now to something completely different!
""")
```
which GitHub markdown renders as a list with three entries, followed by a paragraph:


- code block inside a list with more than one blank line with indentation work
  ```julia
  domaths(x::Number) = x + 5


  domath(x::Int) = x + 10
  ```
- another entry, now testing code blocks without fences

      # this is a code block
      x = 1 + 1
      
      
      # Two empty lines don't interrupt the code
      y = x * 3

- a final list entry

And now to something completely different!
Not sure why this comment was merged as resolved when it isn't? Please also check your other comments for these missing spaces.
thank you for the suggestions, I have made the changes please check
